home.title: idopNetwork Web
home.intro: An online computing platform built around the idopNetwork complex-systems framework. Four modules form a data pipeline: Curve Fitting → FunClu → NetRecon → NetAnal.
home.workspace: No registration; an anonymous workspace is created on your first visit.
tasks.demo.title: Pipeline demo
tasks.demo.description: Validates uploads, queuing, progress, logs, and artifact downloads end to end.
module.curve_fitting.title: Curve Fitting
module.curve_fitting.desc: Quasi-dynamic transformations and power-law fitting; SWT denoising for time series.
module.funclu.title: FunClu
module.funclu.desc: EM Gaussian-mixture functional clustering with BIC selection.
module.netrecon.title: NetRecon
module.netrecon.desc: Single-layer and multi-layer network reconstruction with ASGL, static IDOP, and dynamic IDOP.
module.netanal.title: NetAnal
module.netanal.desc: Network topology analysis with GLMY persistent path homology.
demo.title: Demo task
demo.desc: Create a short run and watch the queue, progress, logs, and artifact download.
